final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM group_averages), retained AS (SELECT g.transref, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg AS earlier_difference FROM group_averages g JOIN overall_average o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.group_avg > o.overall_avg), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS final_avg FROM retained) SELECT r.transref, r.group_avg, r.earlier_difference, r.group_avg - f.final_avg AS final_difference FROM retained r JOIN final_average f ON f.final_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY final_difference DESC LIMIT 10.
